_comment: kalyan-ks/ettin-68m-nemotron-pii entity type -> this repo's 61-label catalogue slug. Only pairs that mean the same thing are listed. Ambiguous upstream types are deliberately ABSENT rather than guessed - 'country' (origin vs residence), 'certificate_license_number' (driver's licence vs professional), 'occupation', 'national_id', 'date'/'time'/'date_time', 'company_name', 'customer_id', 'employee_id', 'unique_id', 'url', 'http_cookie', 'api_key', 'device_identifier', 'fax_number', 'license_plate', 'biometric_identifier', 'blood_type', 'political_view', 'language', 'bank_routing_number' (dropped from the catalogue). A wrong mapping shows up as a model failure and would be read as evidence against the architecture, which is why absence is the safer default.
